custom_scmk03qj.name: Abstract Twisted Torus Sculpture

custom_geometry.code: const geometry = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.5, 0.2, 32, 100); const pos = geometry.attributes.position; const v = new THREE.Vector3(); for(let i=0; i<pos.count; i++){ v.fromBufferAttribute(pos, i); const angle = v.y * 3.0; const x = v.x * Math.cos(angle) - v.z * Math.sin(angle); const z = v.x * Math.sin(angle) + v.z * Math.cos(angle); pos.setXYZ(i, x, v.y, z); } geometry.computeVertexNormals(); return geometry;
